headline: On last trading day, Sensex tumbled 876 points and Nifty fell below 22,900 amid a broad sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 22 October.

why: Investors lost approximately Rs 5 lakh crore in wealth as the Sensex and Nifty crashed
Heavy selling pressure in private bank stocks dragged the overall market sentiment
IT majors including Infosys saw significant declines of around 3% during the session
Nifty breached key support levels to settle below the 22,900 mark
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 20, 2026, in observance of the Dussehra holiday
Analysts warn that Nifty breaking below the 22,800 support level could trigger further bearish momentum
The US is reportedly looking at Reliance Industries to refine Venezuelan oil, potentially impacting the stock
Market participants are monitoring global cues and upcoming corporate results following the sharp Monday decline
summary: In the last trading session on October 19, Indian indices witnessed a major crash with the Sensex falling 876 points and Nifty ending below 22,900. The market is closed today for a scheduled holiday and will resume trading on Thursday, October 22. Significant wealth erosion occurred as heavyweights in the banking and IT sectors faced intense selling pressure.
